endpoint_conventions.sleep_wake_pair: Sleep window between a recorded sleep onset and a subsequent wake entry. Awakenings within the window may be unrecorded.
endpoint_conventions.reported_range: The source gives a time range.
endpoint_conventions.reported_resolution: The source describes an endpoint at this time.
